inherited.recurrent: Within-core count >=core size and density >=3*pool density for both cores.
inherited.retention: Unchanged Stage 1 criterion 8: full A at 60 seconds has Jaccard >=0.8 with A; B also reported.

continued.reference: Frozen stopping cores for specificity, spillover, completion, retention and within-core median.
continued.drift: Jaccard(frozen stopping core, contemporaneous epoch-120 core) >=0.8 for BOTH A/B.

plan.population: Declare every feature ID as an endpoint before addNeuron. Native per-ID seeded assignment applies only to ordinary pool cells. P=round(500/(1-f)); report actual E/I. No type reassignment.
plan.v1: Exact Stage 1g scaffold parameters: g1, w0=1.1, maxWeight=1.65, maxSynapses8, jitter15; diagnostic stopping horizon/continued gate extends to120. One-hit cells are also direct, not subthreshold primed in this comparison.
plan.excitatoryMetrics: All v2 gates and pool density denominators use E only. Native growth, competition and pruning still involve the physical E+I pool. Prune-formed removes all physical pool->pool edges, including I edges. Report the complete typed audit separately.
plan.controls: Growth-off, Hebbian-off, shuffled, untrained, prune-formed, continued-plastic, continued-Hebbian-off; all same inhibitory scaffold. Inhibition-off is the saved 500-E lateral-inhibition v2 primary, at its own stop and epoch120, a common reference rather than a matched-size toggle. Save once and reference explicitly.

reference.verified: Saved v2 primary summary/memory/trials/curve and continued-plastic summary/memory; byte hashes recorded before running.

measurement.edges: At every checkpoint: E->E, E->I, I->E, I->I counts and magnitude/signed quantiles; per-epoch births from native formed events.
measurement.trials: Capture window only, 50+J ticks. I cell IDs and spikes; per-E signed incoming charges, physical arrival times, refractory-discarded inhibitory charge.
measurement.inhibitionBeforeAfferent: Strict native message timestamp < first seed-afferent timestamp, among E with exactly one seed hit. Report both arrived messages and membrane-integrated messages (refractory drops excluded), fired IDs/fraction; simultaneous arrivals do not count as before.
measurement.charge: Unweighted sum of integrated inhibitory magnitudes divided by total E population, not only receivers. Separately report total excitatory charge.
measurement.proxy: For each E spike, raw integrated excitation minus inhibition over ticks [spikeTick-9,spikeTick], including current-tick inputs. This is an effective-threshold proxy, not a reconstructed leaky potential.
measurement.passivity: Non-enumerable native-method observers; no altered calls, return values, config or random draws. Compare observed vs unobserved native circuit bytes in tests.

plan.confirmation: For every seed1 cell whose stopping criterion and all v2 gates including11 pass, run that exact setting on seeds2/3. No other settings. GO requires all gates and inherited required controls on all3 at one setting. If none passes seed1, stop.
plan.exit: 0 diagnostic GO;1 scientific NO-GO;2 execution error. No automatic engine fork.

cueSelection.rule: Greedy first three distinct normalized words in ascending ID order with pairwise-disjoint codes.

patternCompletion.softRule: Both halves at both delays: completion >= 0.7, with the same >= 0.25 gain requirement.

potentiation.quantileMethod: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; empty quantiles are null.

definitions.within: Both endpoints in the named core.
definitions.boundary: Exactly one endpoint in the named core; same boundary as criterion 7.
definitions.betweenCores: Edges between A-only and B-only members, in either direction; shared-core members excluded.

1-stability.rule: Both last-ten-trial mean pairwise Jaccards >= 0.7; strict >= 0.8 reported separately.

2-specificity.rule: Inter-core Jaccard <= 0.2; size is evaluated separately.

4-negative-cue.rule: At both idle durations: nearest-core readback rejects C (< 0.5), C-to-each-core Jaccard <= 0.25, and spillover outside directSet(C) <= 25% of the smaller core.

5-compactness.rule: Observation: each core distance / matched random-subset distance < 0.8; not a Stage 1f gate.

6-recruitment.rule: Report other-cue direct, own-cue primed recruits and cells outside both cues' direct and primed sets; no recruitment gate.

7-recurrent-structure.rule: Each core has >= its size surviving growth-formed internal edges, and internal directed density >= 3 times the pool-wide directed density.

8-retention.rule: Locked A probe after 60 seconds has Jaccard >= 0.8 with core A; B also reported.

9-pattern-completion.rule: For A and B, both fixed halves at both delays: completion >= 0.8 and improvement over the untrained circuit on the same core >= 0.25.

10-potentiation.rule: Each core: median surviving within-core formed weight >= 0.6 (initialWeight + 0.2). Cap fraction >=0.69 is reported only.

11-continued-stability.rule: At 120, gates 2/4/8/9 on frozen stopping cores; both within-core medians >=0.65; each frozen/contemporaneous core Jaccard >=0.8.

structuralAudit.measurement: Native Stage 1e positive-weight and competition observers; full formation history, before any external pruning.
structuralAudit.prediction: Continuous-time afferent-only first threshold crossing: sum stored seed weights with exp(-leakRate*dt) decay, threshold 1.02, then add the native recurrent delay. Inclusive lag 0..0.32 s, after edge birth. Unlike the old one-hit model, a lone afferent cannot predict a spike. Omits inhibition, youth/adaptation, tick rounding and recurrent firing; observed positive events remain separate.
